newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga sees Snorre restart by Friday.
newsitem.headline: Saga sees Snorre restart by Friday.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Wednesday it planned to resume crude production at the Snorre oilfield in the North Sea by Friday.
Output at the 200,000 barrel-per-day development was shut in on Sunday when a short circuit in the main power system caused a blackout.
The main system was restarted on Tuesday, but the platform's auxiliary generators developed a malfunction. Safety regulations require that both systems function before production can restart.
"We are doing repairs to the auxiliary generators so there is still no production and no drilling," Bjoern Schibevaag, Saga's spokesman, told Reuters.
"But we hope to restart on Thursday or Friday. That's the latest plan," he said.
